impact.name: Impact
impact.description: Directly changes what happens in the target plot.

influence.name: Influence
influence.description: Prepares or colours the target plot without changing it right away.

meeting.name: Crossing
meeting.description: Both plots meet at the same moment.

toolbar.tourHint: Walk through the story event by event, on the board
toolbar.readingHint: Read the story with everything attached to it (characters, locations, chapters, notes…)

board.dragLane: Click to select it, drag to move it
board.handle: Drag to another event to create a link
board.actHint: Start of an act: click to edit

empty.title: Your plot is empty
empty.hint: Double-click a column to place a first event, or create events from the structure (“…” menu).

board.tensionHelp: Click or drag to draw the tension; double-click to clear a moment
board.noLanesHint: All plots have been deleted. Add one: the first one becomes the main plot.
board.allHiddenHint: Show one from the View menu.
board.unplacedHint: Events not told in any structure item. Click to highlight them on the board.
board.storyStartHint: Above: the narrative past (flashbacks, memories, earlier events). Scroll up to go back in time.

reading.emptyHint: Place events on the plot board: they will read here, with their characters, locations, chapters and notes.
reading.noNote: Nothing is written yet about what happens.

issues.title: Automatic checks
issues.hint: Invitations to look at the structure, not errors: nothing is fixed automatically.
issues.none: Nothing to report: every plot is connected and time flows the right way.
issues.untitled: An event in “{{lane}}” has no title (moment {{moment}}).
issues.mainGap: The main plot stays empty for {{count}} moments before “{{title}}”.
issues.laneIsolated: The plot “{{lane}}” is not linked to any other.
issues.laneUnreached: The plot “{{lane}}” never reaches the main plot, even indirectly.
issues.backInTime: The link “{{title}}” goes back in time.
issues.badDate: The date of “{{title}}” ({{date}}) is not recognised.
issues.mysteryNoAnswer: The mystery “{{question}}” is marked solved but has no answer.
issues.noPivot: No turning point is marked in the story.

mysteries.hint: A mystery is a question whose answer the reader awaits. Plant its clues in events and pick the event of the revelation.
mysteries.question: Question
mysteries.questionPlaceholder: What is the reader trying to understand?

event.title: Title
event.notePlaceholder: Action, revelation, decision, what changes for the character…
event.nodeHint: The structure item (chapter, scene…) where the event is told: it sets the reading order and links to the chapter's documents.
event.writeSceneHint: Creates a note linked to this event and opens it
event.preferScene: This item contains scenes: pick a scene instead for a more precise reading order.
event.alsoNodesHint: Other scenes where the event is told again (memory, other point of view). The main scene sets its place in the reading.
event.momentHint: 1, 2, 3…: the main story. −1, −2…: the narrative past, before the story begins.

link.backInTime: This link goes back in time: the target comes before the source. Fine for a flashback; otherwise reverse the link.
link.label: Link name (shown on the board)

lane.name: Plot name
lane.delete: Delete the plot and its events

row.label: Moment label
row.deleteBlocked: A moment can only be deleted when empty

view.title: Plot display
view.rowLinesHint: Unchecked hides the horizontal lines; act starts stay marked.

tour.label: Story walk-through

modes.structureHint: The board order, moment by moment
modes.readingHint: The order in which the reader discovers the story
modes.laneHint: Follow a single plot from start to end

tour.fullReadingHint: Open the story reading at this event

templates.title: Structure templates
templates.description: Pick a template to place its acts and main beats on the moments, create your own, or apply none.

three.name: Three acts
three.description: The classic structure: setup, confrontation, resolution.

hero.name: Hero's journey (summary)
hero.description: Twelve stages inspired by Joseph Campbell and Christopher Vogler.

stc.name: Save the Cat (simplified)
stc.description: Blake Snyder's fifteen beats condensed into ten.

circle.name: Eight-point circle
circle.description: Comfort, need, the unknown, trials, return transformed.

five.name: Five acts (Freytag)
five.description: The classic dramatic pyramid: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, resolution.

seven.name: Seven-point structure
seven.description: Dan Wells: start from the ending and build the path to it.

kishotenketsu.name: Kishōtenketsu
kishotenketsu.description: A four-part structure from East Asia, common in manga, with no mandatory conflict.

fichtean.name: Fichtean curve
fichtean.description: A series of ever-stronger crises, ideal for suspense.

spine.name: Story spine
spine.description: Kenn Adams: “Once upon a time… until one day…”

mystery.name: Mystery
mystery.description: The beats of a detective plot, from the crime to the reveal.

romance.name: Romance
romance.description: The main beats of a love story, from meeting to ending.

templates.mineEmpty: No personal template yet. Create your own: one step per line.
templates.name: Template name
templates.stepsHint_other: {{count}} steps, spread from the first to the last moment.
templates.clear: Remove the acts from the board

import.title: Events from the structure
import.description: Creates one event for each item of a structure level (each chapter, for instance), in outline order, linked to that item and with its summary.
import.noStructure: The structure is empty: create parts, chapters or scenes in the story outline first.
import.skip: Skip items already linked to an event

toasts.laneHidden: Plot hidden. Use “Display” to show it again.

description.character: Events where {{name}} appears or carries the point of view.

empty.character: This character does not appear in any plot event yet.
empty.location: No plot event takes place here yet.
empty.node: No plot event is told here yet.

settings.colorsHint: Each plot's colour on the board, in the reading and on the sheets. New plots get a free colour automatically.

scene.retoldTitle: Told again here (memory, other point of view…)
scene.unlinkHint: Remove from this scene (the event stays in the plot)
scene.preferScenes: This item contains scenes: link events to the scenes instead for a more precise reading order.
scene.addNew: Add an event to this scene
scene.noLane: Create a plot on the board first.
scene.asRetoldHint: The event keeps its main scene (which sets its place in the reading) and also appears here.

plan.noEventsHint: No plot event is told in this scene (scene sheet › In the plot).
